changeSet.author: Víctor Cañizares

preConditions.onFailMessage: Cannot bind the active-token index of one_time_token to platform-admin invitations: platform_admin_invitation_id is missing, one_time_token_one_active_uq is missing or is not the index bound to memberships, or one_time_token_platform_admin_invitation_one_active_uq already exists. Inspect with: SELECT indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'one_time_token';
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'one_time_token' AND indexname = 'one_time_token_one_active_uq' AND indexdef LIKE '%(user_id, purpose) WHERE ((membership_id IS NULL) AND (used_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL))'
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'one_time_token' AND indexname = 'one_time_token_platform_admin_invitation_one_active_uq'

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_time_token_one_active_uq ON one_time_token (user_id, purpose) WHERE membership_id IS NULL AND platform_admin_invitation_id IS NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_time_token_platform_admin_invitation_one_active_uq ON one_time_token (platform_admin_invitation_id) WHERE platform_admin_invitation_id IS NOT NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM one_time_token WHERE platform_admin_invitation_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_time_token_one_active_uq ON one_time_token (user_id, purpose) WHERE membership_id IS NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
